note: wait poll suite: every program that waits for the PVR, polled; the first entry is the sleeping-against-polled test

tests.name: waitpoll
tests.what: Sleep vs polled wait, 6 shapes, graphs. ~1 min
tests.read: photo every page, the graphs especially
tests.title: Sleeping vs polled wait
tests.shows: Times the PVR wait two ways, sleeping and polled

card.what: Times the PVR wait two ways, sleeping and polled, in six shapes, and draws the results as graphs.
card.controls: Automatic run, about one minute. A and B turn the pages, Start on the last page runs it again. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Not measured yet: this disc is the first console run of the polled wait in this program.
